title: Chanel N°5 Extrait Baccarat: A Limited Edition Masterpiece for the Holidays - Harper's Bazaar Singapore

 The house’s most iconic fragrance gets a hand-engraved crystal home this holiday season, with Le Chalet de Chanel waiting in the wings for everyone else on your list.
 Photo: Arissa Ha By  Arissa Ha  -  published 30 Oct 2026 
 Of all the forms N°5 has taken over the past century, the extrait is the one perfume lovers tend to wear most closely. It’s the richest, most concentrated version of the scent, worn in dabs rather than spritzes, and this holiday season, Chanel has given it a setting to match: a Baccarat crystal flacon released in an edition of just 48 pieces worldwide.
 Chanel and Baccarat have done this before. To mark the fragrance’s centenary in 2021, the house filled a crystal bottle with 2,021ml of N°5, a number that nodded to the year and, rather neatly, adds up to five, and made only 55 of them. This time, the scale has come right down to 50ml, which turns it into a collector’s piece you can actually keep on your dresser and wear on the daily.

 A Cut Above the Rest
 Photo: Courtesy of Chanel Each bottle is blown and polished entirely by hand, then numbered and engraved by hand, so no two are exactly alike. The stopper is sealed using baudruchage, an old perfumery technique in which a fine membrane is stretched over the neck and tied off with thread, and one that very few fragrances are still finished with today.
 The whole thing arrives in a jewel case of white lambskin cut to echo the faceted outline of the N°5 stopper. Look inside the lid and you’ll find a small thread-cutter modelled on Japanese scissors, which makes breaking the seal for the first time feel like an occasion in itself.
 The Grasse Is Always Greener
 Photo: Courtesy of Chanel As for what’s inside, the extrait leans on the flowers Chanel grows for itself in Grasse, where the Mul family has tended the house’s fields for five generations. Jasmine from those fields is blended with Chanel’s May rose, neroli from Vallauris and ylang-ylang from the Comoros, all wrapped around the aldehydes that have made N°5 recognisable since 1921.
 Gabrielle Chanel famously advised wearing perfume wherever you’d like to be kissed, and an extrait, which sits close to the skin rather than trailing across a room, is made for exactly that kind of placement. Think the inside of the wrists, behind the ears or the base of the throat, and go easy, since a little goes a very long way.
 Related article: Inside The Mul Farm: Harvesting The Jasmine Flower That Goes Into The Iconic Chanel Nº5 
 Lucky Number Five 
 Singapore has been allocated five of the 48 bottles, numbered 8, 29, 31, 38 and 42. If one of those happens to be your lucky number, or the year of a birthday or anniversary worth marking, consider this your sign to go and claim it before someone else does.
 Snow Place Like Home 
 Photo: Courtesy of Chanel In the spirit of the season, discover Chanel’s holiday collection, starring Le Chalet de Chanel, a limited-edition cabinet styled like an Alpine hideaway and perched on a gilded sled, its white doors opening onto gold panels painted with snowy fir trees and Gabrielle Chanel’s signature.
 Each compartment holds something to unwrap. On the fragrance side, there’s a full 100ml bottle of N°5 Eau de Parfum, a 7ml purse spray of Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum dressed for the holidays, Comète Fragranced Body Oil and the new Paris-St. Moritz. The makeup is all limited-edition holiday pieces: Les 4 Ombres in Ombre d’Or and Neige d’Or, and two lipsticks from 31 Le Rouge: Rouge Féérie in a matte finish and Rose Enchanté in satin.
 What makes the chalet feel like an heirloom are the five Christmas tree ornaments tucked in among the beauty. There’s a white leather camellia made entirely by hand, a gold metal ornament shaped like snowy peaks and plated in micron gold by Maison Hamon , and a frosted glass bauble mouth-blown by one of France’s oldest glassmakers. A ceramic scented with N°5 comes from a ceramist in Limoges, the French region long celebrated for its porcelain, while the gold leather snowflake is handmade and covered completely in gold leaf, using a cutting technique developed specially for Chanel. Hang them on the tree this year and pack them away carefully for every December after.
 The N°5 Extrait Baccarat ($8,150) and Le Chalet de Chanel ($3,600) are available now in limited quantities at Chanel Boutiques.
